---
name: 实验点子 / Experiment idea
about: 想玩但还没人写方案的点子（An idea worth playing with, not yet written up）
title: "[idea] "
labels: ["idea"]
---

**一句话：这个实验想验证什么？**
One line: what would this experiment prove or measure?

**为什么有意思？**
Why is it interesting?

**大概需要什么设备 / 花费？**
What gear does it need, roughly what does it cost?

**你自己做过吗？做过的话结果如何？**
Have you tried it? What happened?
